# @vllnt/convex-music

> TypeScript Convex component for a cached music catalog: tracks, artists, albums and playlists from Spotify, Apple Music and Deezer, plus MusicBrainz artists.

Install `@vllnt/convex-music` (unreleased builds from `main` use the `canary`
dist-tag). Peer dependency `convex@^1.45.0`; optional `react@^18 || ^19` for
the `./react` hooks. Mount it with `app.use(music)` from
`@vllnt/convex-music/convex.config` and call it through
`new Music(components.music)` from host queries, mutations and actions.

Two stores in the component's own tables: a raw cache (`put`, `get`,
`getByIsrc`, `invalidate`, `pruneExpired`, `stats`; optional TTL per entry)
and a durable catalog of artists, tracks (keyed by ISRC), albums and playlists
(`upsert*`, `get*`,
`searchArtists`, `searchTracks`, `selectEligible`). Artists and tracks merge
every provider's facts into one row; albums and playlists keep one row per
provider id. Actions call providers:
`fetchArtist`, `fetchTrack`, `search`, `resolveByIsrc` and the imports
`importArtist`, `importTrack`, `importPlaylist`, `importAlbum`, which return
`{ requestId, status }` and record provider errors on the request instead of
throwing. Providers: Spotify and Apple Music (credentials passed with
`configure`, since a component cannot read environment variables), Deezer,
MusicBrainz and Wikidata (no credentials; MusicBrainz and Wikidata supply
artists only). Built-in crons prune the cache, mark rows stale and refresh
them, and import registered sources (`sources.mutations.addSource`). Invalid
input throws `ConvexError` with `data.code` `INVALID_ARGUMENT`, `INVALID_TTL`,
`INVALID_LIMIT`, `INVALID_COUNT`, `INVALID_CADENCE` or `INVALID_BATCH`. The
host owns auth and gameplay or editorial data.
Multiple catalogs per mount and artist-image auto-sync are planned, not built.

## When to use

- Use it when a Convex app needs a music catalog that it can search and read in
  queries: artists, tracks keyed by ISRC, albums and playlists.
- Use it when artist and track facts come from more than one provider and must
  merge into one row.
- Use it when imports and periodic refreshes should run inside Convex.
- Do not use it when you only need to cache one provider API call: use
  `@convex-dev/action-cache`.

## For coding agents

The docs are bundled in the package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-music/` and
match the installed version. Read them, and the shipped `src/`, before writing
code. The links below to `./` paths are files inside the installed package.

## Docs

- [README](./README.md): Install, quick start, common tasks, limits
- [API Reference](./docs/API.md): Every export, signature, return shape, cron and validation rule
- [Errors and fixes](./README.md#errors-and-fixes): Every error code and message, its cause and the fix
- [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md): Version history and release notes
- [Client source](./src/client/index.ts): The `Music` class and its input types
- [Contributing](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-music/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, validation commands, release workflow (repository only)
